backgrounds.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait mobile puzzle game background, 1024x1536 portrait composition. One single full-bleed vertical background, no borders, panels, collage, UI, lettering, logo, watermark, people, cannons or game blocks. CRITICAL: central 65% width from top to 80% height is quiet open gently graded atmosphere with very few details, because colored puzzle blocks overlay the center. Keep scenery at extreme left/right margins and lowest 20%. Attractive decorative scenery with depth and sophisticated colors, restrained contrast. Rounded waffle cliffs and small scoops of strawberry and mint ice cream confined to bottom corners, calm pale aqua ocean horizon very low, gentle creamy clouds near top corners. Center is open pale aqua-blue sky and smooth calm distant water, no islands in center.
